risks.mitigation: Use factual alt text, visible hybrid conceptual-image captions where appropriate, and adjacent project copy. Identify only the preserved public-product layer as authentic interface evidence, and never describe its generated surroundings as screenshot content, a real setting, or product proof.

Keep synthetic disclosure visible and consistent; prohibit fabricated readable text, interface states, metrics, testimonials, facilities, staff identities, and outcome claims. Require checksum reconciliation and full-size visual review for every final master. Sustainable-abundance imagery must not imply a real kingXford & Co facility, project, partnership, feasibility result, or measured performance.
Use optimized local WebP plates, CSS/Motion transforms, native scroll, and a reduced-motion static path.
Deploy and verify the Vercel production URL; treat custom-domain DNS as a separate owner-controlled configuration.

Record reference and publication years, retain official links and interpretation boundaries beside every visual, and re-verify figures before a dated article update rather than silently replacing values.
